title: Quick Fermented Ayurvedic Polish Dish Bowl
description: Satisfy your Ayurvedic cravings with a quick fermentation process using shio-cure and a hint of sour cream, then enjoy this Polish-inspired dish bowl.

ingredients.name: Shio-cure Beef
ingredients.notes: Use store-bought or homemade shio-cure beef.

ingredients.name: Finely Chopped Onion
ingredients.notes: Red onion or any other sweet onion variety.

ingredients.name: Dried Thyme
ingredients.notes: For a hint of herbal flavor.

ingredients.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: For a light and refreshing taste.

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the soaked shio-cure beef and chopped onion, and let it sit at room temperature for 4 hours to ferment.
After fermentation, rinse the beef mixture with cold water and drain well.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the fermented beef mixture until it's lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat the brown rice according to package instructions.

To assemble the bowl, place a scoop of brown rice, then top it with the fermented beef mixture, followed by a dollop of sour cream, sprinkle with thyme, salt to taste, and garnish with parsley and dill.
